text: The founding proclamation names 5 June 2025 as the date of foundation.
uncertainty_note: BHF/002/2025 and BHF/003/2025 are both dated 5 June 2025; their order within that date is not stated.

text: The National Day Proclamation says that 5 June shall be observed annually as the National Day of the Bhoomi Federation.
uncertainty_note: The annual recurrence is stated in BHF/002/2025 and BHF/003/2025, not in the National Calendar document BHF/005/2025.

text: The founding proclamation names the values clarity of thought, ethical governance, dignity of individual existence, and collective peace.
uncertainty_note: These are the values named in the founding record; no later programme or implementation is documented here.

text: BHF/001/2025 describes adoption of a vertical blue-white-green triband.
uncertainty_note: The PDF text extraction gives green #008A45 while Archive.org OCR metadata gives #008445; verify the original visual record before using an exact color value or flag rendering.

text: BHF/004/2025 designates individuals granted citizenship under the Federation's legal and administrative framework as Bhoomians.
uncertainty_note: The document does not define eligibility or a process for granting citizenship; no present-day availability is implied.

text: BHF/005/2025 lists Monday through Friday as working days, Saturday and Sunday as non-working days, and 5 June as the sole public holiday; it says government offices remain closed on that day.
uncertainty_note: The annual National Day recurrence is sourced to BHF/002/2025 and BHF/003/2025; BHF/005/2025 itself lists 5 June as the sole holiday.

text: The former public website described dignity, justice, welfare, ethical governance, universal welfare, and philosophical leadership.
uncertainty_note: These are historical public-facing statements, not a detailed constitution, active policy programme, or evidence of current institutions.

text: “Republic of Harmonia” and “Melvin Welfare Dominion” are unresolved research leads supplied in the project brief, not names established by the reviewed original records or legacy pages.
uncertainty_note: No reviewed primary record or legacy page confirms either name; do not place them in an established chronology.
